brand.name: MotionBrief
brand.tagline: A brief your agent can't drift from.

beats.notes: Three brief lines are on screen at frame 0. A rounded square draws around them, the lines morph into a play triangle cut into three bands, the square floods accent, the mark slides left as the wordmark rises letter by letter. Exit zooms through the triangle.

copy: Describe the video in one sentence.
beats.notes: Arrives out of the zoom. 'one sentence.' gets an accent sweep. Exit: the words collapse into a centred { } glyph that the next beat opens from.

copy: Every cut, every hold, every word.
beats.notes: The { } opens into a brief.json panel: a 120 BPM beat ruler, five beat blocks snap onto the grid, a playhead sweeps and lights each tick it passes. Exit: whip-pan left.
Four phrases stamp in on eighth notes, last one in accent. Exit pushes up, finishing on the cut.

copy: A brief your agent can't drift from.

assumptions: Purpose: the intro video at the top of the repo README, so 1920x1080 landscape.
60 fps as requested; 17 s so each idea gets one beat-length idea plus a 2.6 s closing hold.
The logo is new: a rounded square holding three 'brief' text lines that morph into a play triangle cut into three bands — brief becomes motion.
Brand name written 'MotionBrief' (as asked) with 'Brief' in the accent colour.

Copy is lifted verbatim from the README: the tagline, 'Describe the video in one sentence.', 'every cut, every hold, every word', 'Same brief, same cuts, same words, byte-identical music.' and the install command.
Palette kept from the existing template (near-black, near-white, ice-blue #7dd3fc) so it matches the README badges.
Inter and JetBrains Mono loaded from Google Fonts.
Music generated at 120 BPM in A minor; every cut lands on the 0.5 s grid.
